projects.name: Cybersecurity Tabletop Exercise (ROMERO Simulation)
projects.card: Evaluated real-world cyber threats — ransomware, phishing, credential leaks, and supply-chain attacks — and developed risk-based defense strategies within a fixed budget, prioritizing controls like access management and network segmentation.
projects.desc: Evaluated ransomware, phishing, credential-leak and supply-chain threats and built risk-based defense strategies within a fixed budget.
projects.title: Cybersecurity Tabletop Exercise | Jacqueline Magawa
projects.metaDesc: Jacqueline Magawa's cybersecurity tabletop exercise: ransomware, phishing, credential leaks and supply-chain attacks, defended on a fixed budget.
did: Evaluated four real-world threat types in a simulated organization: ransomware, phishing, credential leaks, and supply-chain attacks.
Weighed each threat by risk to decide where defenses matter most.
Built defense strategies that had to fit within a fixed budget.
Prioritized high-impact controls such as access management and network segmentation.
related: Cybersecurity fundamentals on the skills checklist

projects.name: Interpreter for a Custom Programming Language
projects.card: Built a fully functional interpreter in Java — lexer, recursive descent parser, and AST evaluator — supporting variables, control flow, and function calls, with a custom grammar designed from scratch.
projects.desc: A Java interpreter with a lexer, recursive descent parser and AST evaluator supporting variables, control flow and functions.
projects.title: Java Interpreter for a Custom Language | Jacqueline Magawa
projects.metaDesc: Jacqueline Magawa built a Java interpreter for a custom language: lexer, recursive descent parser and AST evaluator with variables, control flow and functions.
did: Designed a custom grammar for a new programming language from scratch.
Wrote a lexer that turns source code into tokens.
Built a recursive descent parser that turns tokens into an abstract syntax tree (AST).
Implemented an AST evaluator that runs programs, with variables, control flow, and function calls.
related: Languages & tools on the skills checklist
Computer Science coursework at University at Albany

projects.name: SolarWinds Supply Chain Attack — Case Study
projects.card: Analyzed APT29's 2020 supply-chain compromise using the MITRE ATT&CK framework — mapping Golden SAML attacks, lateral movement, and C2 evasion across 18,000+ affected organizations through the CIA Triad and defense-in-depth lenses.
projects.desc: Analysis of APT29's 2020 supply-chain compromise using MITRE ATT&CK, the CIA Triad and defense-in-depth.
projects.title: SolarWinds Attack Case Study | Jacqueline Magawa
projects.metaDesc: Jacqueline Magawa's case study of APT29's 2020 SolarWinds supply-chain attack, mapped with MITRE ATT&CK: Golden SAML, lateral movement and C2 evasion.
did: Studied APT29's 2020 compromise of the SolarWinds software supply chain.
Mapped the attackers' techniques to the MITRE ATT&CK framework, including Golden SAML attacks, lateral movement, and C2 evasion.
Assessed the impact across more than 18,000 affected organizations.
Evaluated the breach through the CIA Triad (confidentiality, integrity, availability) and defense-in-depth.
related: Cybersecurity fundamentals on the skills checklist
